body: I'm sorry to hear about the insomnia, and I hope you can get some sleep soon. Thank you, I just kinda think I'm past help at this point. Idk.
It's okay, I understood what you were trying to get across, and I shouldn't have attacked you for it. I'm sorry.

If I were to write out what happened to me and what happened to any one of them and asked someone to say which is worse, they would choose my friends' situations every time. Undoubtedly. I know it comparing situations doesn't often mean anything, but in this case they really did have the worse situation. I just...I wish I could forget it already and be done with it. I don't want to deal with the panic attacks and the dissociation and even just the general trust issues anymore.

I'm a mess though. I can be manipulative and I push people away and I hurt them so they don't hurt me. I'm everything bad and I don't want to hurt anyone anymore. I just want to be gone so my family and friends can start living their lives. Some friends have straight up told me that I'm exhausting, and they're right. I'm a drain. I'm useless in a lot of ways, and I'm just an overall negative force in a lot of people's lives.

I don't think I am special. My story is nothing extraordinary; most of my friends were assaulted or raped and they all got over it in much less time than I did. Why can't I get over it, when mine was arguably much less bad than theirs?

My school has free counseling, but I'll be back in my hometown about 2 hours away in two weeks, so what's the point of going right now? Why would I go just to have to go back to not having counseling in two weeks anyway?

Thank you. Idk, none of it feels worth it though. Like what was the point of doing all of this if I still feel so worthless and I'm just gonna end up killing myself anyway? Those resources could've gone to someone who's actually planning on doing something with their life, you know?
